# TextField

A 49px text input with a floating label. Empty, it shows the label as a placeholder. Filled, a 12px label sits above the value. The switch is pure CSS, so browser autofill works too.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/textfield)

## Usage

```tsx
const [city, setCity] = useState('');

<TextField
  label="City"
  value={city}
  onChange={event => setCity(event.target.value)}
  error={cityError}
  autoComplete="address-level2"
/>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | Placeholder while empty, small label once filled. Always rendered as a real &lt;label>. |
| `error` | `string \| null` | Red border and a message that opens underneath. Sets aria-invalid and aria-describedby. |
| `accessory` | `ReactNode` | Icon or tooltip button at the end of the field. |
| `below` | `ReactNode` | Content under the field, above the error: a hint, a suggestion list. |
| `dir` | `'ltr' \| 'rtl' \| 'auto'` | Direction of the typed text. By default a filled field takes it from what was typed, so English in a Hebrew form (or the reverse) reads correctly. Set "ltr" for numbers and codes. |
| `…input` | `InputHTMLAttributes` | Everything else goes to the &lt;input>: value, onChange, autoComplete, inputMode. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `TextField.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/primitives/Field`](../Field)
- [`src/primitives/FieldError`](../FieldError)
- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
